reason: The plugin audits which workspace instruction events affected a Harness session by recording structured metadata and content digests in local JSONL receipts without reading or storing instruction text.

summaries.zh: 记录 DeepSeek Harness 会话中实际发出的工作区指令事件元数据与内容摘要，生成可供审计的本地 JSONL 回执。
summaries.en: Records metadata and content digests for workspace instruction events emitted in DeepSeek Harness sessions, producing local JSONL receipts for auditing.

capabilities: Observes durable agent-instructions events emitted by the active Harness
Records session and event metadata plus producer-owned content digests
Writes JSONL receipts to a configurable local directory
Provides a CLI to read receipts for a session
